description: Planted tie among the training bests: S=2, N=3. Every block holds the 2 intervals (m-1, m+1), so count=2, sum=2m, m2=2 and the ranking statistic of a one-block half is m/sqrt(2). Block means (block 0, block 1): trial 0 = (4, 3), trial 1 = (4, 1), trial 2 = (1, 2). Trials 0 and 1 have identical block 0 moments, so they tie exactly when block 0 trains. Hand count in tests/python/test_pbo.py.
